desc: 暗夜质感男表，大数字表盘与疯马皮表带，四色可选，礼赠收口
leaf: 男士复古疯马皮表带大表盘腕表
name: 复古疯马皮大表盘男表款

shots.intent: 用暗调气场与正面大表盘抢第一眼点击，一秒立住硬朗男士礼品质感。
shots.textZone: left column: headline plus two short proof labels stacked above a hairline rule

shots.intent: 只拍手腕与袖口让买家自我代入，把表放进真实穿搭与送礼语境而不依赖面孔。
微距证明表盘刻度、指针与日历窗的印刷与装配质量，替代表面口号。
shots.textZone: right ivory panel: one label plus one short sub-label

shots.intent: 用 90 度侧面交代壳厚、表冠滚花与按键手感结构，回答做工疑问。
在亮底面板上微距扣带、铆钉与撞色缝线，用材质对比撑住价值感。
shots.textZone: right margin: one label plus one short sub-label

shots.intent: 低角度后侧特写底盖拉丝与圈口台阶，用金属加工细节建立品质信任。
正上方一排四色让买家直接选款，用统一机位与光保证颜色准确。
shots.textZone: top band: one headline plus four short colour labels

shots.intent: 亮底规格屏用引线标注消解尺寸疑虑，数值留给后期真实参数填写。
shots.textZone: hairline dimension leader lines around case and strap plus a top title band, all copy as placeholders

shots.intent: 俯视平铺真实随附件，用可见内容物而非证书降低下单风险。
shots.textZone: bottom band: three short proof labels

shots.intent: 回到暗调主视觉收口，用礼赠语境与按钮位承接下单动作。
shots.textZone: top headline band plus a rounded button at the lower right

style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep-charcoal studio field and black-streaked wood surface, with ivory info panels for spec screens
style.iconSystem: minimal thin-line outline icons and single circular markers in #C9A227 at 1.5px stroke, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: soft directional key from the upper left, controlled specular rim on metal edges, low-contrast fill, always a soft contact shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-toned men's watch commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #0B1015, graphite #1C2228, ivory neutral #F2EFE6, and one brushed-brass accent #C9A227; neutral tone; one font family only, modern geometric sans-serif with a clean Chinese sans for callouts; alternating background system of a deep charcoal studio field and a black-streaked wood surface #14100D; soft directional key light from the upper left with a controlled specular rim on metal and a soft contact shadow; minimal thin-line outline icons and circular markers with hairline rules; stable product angle with dial numerals and hands legible, strap colours hex-pinned, macro reserved for dial, crown, buckle and caseback, no human face in frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no sparkle artifacts, no duplicated watch parts.
noDrift: no visible faces or brand wordmarks
style.presentationRules: same case geometry and strap stitch colour in every shot; dial numerals and hands kept crisp and squared to camera; strap colours hex-pinned; macro limited to dial, crown, buckle and caseback; no human face ever in frame, wrist or hand cropped at the cuff
style.surfaceSystem: black-streaked wood grain #14100D and matte charcoal plinths; natural linen #E4DED2 only on the flat-lay trust screen
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Latin plus a clean Chinese sans for callouts, hairline rules, no serif or handwritten faces
